post.description: The request body is a GraphQL-over-HTTP JSON payload. At minimum, include a query field. Two main query patterns are supported: Data queries: Retrieve event records with filtering, sorting, and pagination using cursor-based first, after, hasNextPage, and endCursor.Introspection queries: Discover available types and their fields using __type to explore schema structure. Examples of both patterns are documented in app-feature-events-queries.md and surfaced as Swagger examples for this endpoint.

Discover event_app_feature fields.summary: Introspection query to explore available fields on the event_app_feature type.

value.query: { __type(name: "event_app_feature") { name fields { name type { name kind ofType { name kind } } } } }

Filter by app key.summary: Find feature events for a single app key.

value.query: { event_app_features(first: 100, orderBy: { event_date: DESC }, filter: { data_appkey: { eq: "pss-portfolio" } }) { items { event_id event_date data_appkey data_feature data_body_data user_id } hasNextPage endCursor } }

Filter by date range.summary: Restrict events to a time window.

value.query: { event_app_features(first: 100, orderBy: { event_date: DESC }, filter: { event_date: { gte: "2026-01-01", lte: "2026-06-01" } }) { items { event_id event_date data_appkey data_feature user_id } hasNextPage endCursor } }

First 100 events.summary: Most recent events with cursor pagination.

value.query: { event_app_features(first: 100, orderBy: { event_date: DESC }) { items { event_id event_date event_name data_appkey data_feature data_context_id data_context_type data_context_title data_context_source data_context_external_id data_body_data portal_id user_id session_id } hasNextPage endCursor } }

Next page.summary: Use the endCursor from the previous response as after.

value.query: { event_app_features(first: 100, after: "<endCursor>", orderBy: { event_date: DESC }) { items { event_id event_date event_name data_appkey data_feature data_context_id data_context_type data_context_title data_context_source data_context_external_id data_body_data portal_id user_id session_id } hasNextPage endCursor } }
